messages:
maya: Heads-up — drafting the internal announcement for tomorrow's rollout (change window 03:00-05:00 UTC). Need quick sign-off on the release notes blurb and the pin/rollback wording.

elena: can you paste the short RN blurb here? i'll skim. :eyes:

maya: sure — copying draft: ```Release 2026.1 — Improved batching & fix for token-level caching regressions. Pin to model v2.7.1 for stability. Canary: 10% traffic -> 1h evaluation. Rollback: auto-fallback to v2.6.9 if error rate > 2.5% for 5m.```

raj: quick nit: change "Pin to model v2.7.1" -> "Pinned default model: v2.7.1 (canary will run on v2.7.2-experimental)" — ops asked to avoid ambiguous pin language.

maya: good call. updated.

sam: SRE question — the DB migration in the queue (read-only index update) might spike latency at minute 30 of the window. Can we shift the canary start to +15m after migration completes?

elena: we should avoid moving the change window if possible, but delaying canary start is fine. raj / ops: how long is the migration expected?

jordan: migration ETA 12m (with buffer). I can coordinate to start it on 03:05 so canary kicks at 03:25. That keeps the rollback window intact.

sre-oncall: If we're doing an auto rollback threshold, ensure the deploy bot has the correct metric path: `latency.p50.service` is the one we monitor for the index update spike. Don't use p95 for the rollback trigger.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: rollout job created by @maya. Canary traffic 10% -> 1h -> auto-roll decision enabled. Job id: rb-241789.

maya: Thanks. One more ask — we need the internal announcement to include clear owner lines: who to page for Sev1, who owns rollback, and who owns comms. Suggest: Sev1 -> @sre-oncall, Rollback exec -> @raj, Comms -> @elena.

raj: fine with rollback ownership. I'll be on desktop during the window.

elena: i'll handle the internal note and the external changelog snippet. Draft internal note: "Planned rollout 03:00-05:00 UTC. Expect minor latency blips during DB index migration. Canary will start after migration. Pinned default model: v2.7.1. If auto-rollback triggers, traffic will fall back to v2.6.9 and we will open a Sev channel." Anything to add?

sam: add link to quick rollback runbook: https://wiki.redwood/rollbacks#v2x — also include the alert playbook name `deploy.rollback.critical`.

maya: added. Also adding a short snippet for support: one-liner they can paste to customers: "We're performing a planned rollout to improve inference stability. You may see transient latency; we've pinned the production model and have automated fallback in place."

sre-oncall: +1. Also please include the TTL for KV cache clear in the RN — it will be cleared during canary and can cause some extra cold-token latency for ~5m.

maya: good catch. updated RN: `KV cache clear during canary; expect ~5m of increased cold-start latency for affected routes.`

deploy-bot: rb-241789 progressing: canary started at 2417890125, 10% traffic, health checks passing.

sam: monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/boards/deploys/rb-241789 — I see p50 up 18% during migration minute 10-12, stable after.

raj: we keep auto-rollback thresholds at error rate > 2.5% for 5m. Right now errors are at 0.8% and trending down. I recommend we proceed to ramp to 50% at +45m if no regressions.

elena: copy for internal announcement ready. maya — want me to post now or wait for ramp decision?

maya: wait to post public internal note until ramp to 50% is confirmed. Post a tiny heads-up to #eng for visibility: "rolling out 03:00 UTC, canary started; detailed note once ramp confirmed."

maya: final check: pinned default model line confirmed as "Pinned default model: v2.7.1 (canary: v2.7.2-experimental)." Rollback: v2.6.9 auto-fallback. Canary delay handled. RN + owners + runbook links all included. Approve? :thumbsup:

elena: :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rb-241789 update: ramp to 50% scheduled at 2417890425 after manual approval window.

maya: thanks everyone — i'll post full internal announcement once ramp is green. If anything changes, post here.

(End of thread)
